description: This file contains unit tests for the AccountGrain functionality in an Orleans-based event sourcing system, including balance operations and transaction log retrieval.

classes.name: AccountGrainTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the AccountGrain, testing balance operations and transaction logging with and without log storage.

methods.name: TestSequence
methods.description: Performs a sequence of deposit and withdrawal operations on an account and verifies the balance and transaction log behavior based on whether logs are stored.

methods.name: AccountWithLog
methods.description: Test case for an account that supports transaction logging.

methods.name: AccountWithoutLog
methods.description: Test case for an account that does not support transaction logging.
